command:
set -eu
policy=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-remote-access.conf
candidate=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/.60-remote-access.conf.candidate
if [ -e "$policy" ]; then
  printf 'refusing_to_overwrite_existing=%s\n' "$policy" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' '# Restrict SSH authentication to the designated local access group.' 'AllowGroups remote-access' > "$candidate"
chown root:root "$candidate"
chmod 0644 "$candidate"
mv "$candidate" "$policy"
if ! /usr/sbin/sshd -t; then
  rm -f "$policy"
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' '--- installed policy ---'
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' "$policy"
cat "$policy"
printf '%s\n' '--- effective access directive ---'
/usr/sbin/sshd -T -C "user=opsadmin,host=$NODE_NAME,addr=$NODE_IP" | grep '^allowgroups '

set -eu
test_user=ssh-policy-denied-test
test_dir=/root/.ssh-access-policy-test
if getent passwd "$test_user" >/dev/null; then
  printf 'refusing_existing_test_user=%s\n' "$test_user" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -e "$test_dir" ]; then
  printf 'refusing_existing_test_dir=%s\n' "$test_dir" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -m 0700 "$test_dir"
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'temporary access-policy validation' -f "$test_dir/id_ed25519"
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Temporary SSH policy validation' "$test_user"
ops_password=[REDACTED] rand -base64 36)
test_password=[REDACTED] rand -base64 36)
printf 'opsadmin:%s\n%s:%s\n' "$ops_password" "$test_user" "$test_password" | chpasswd
unset ops_password test_password
install -d -o opsadmin -g opsadmin -m 0700 /home/opsadmin/.ssh
install -o opsadmin -g opsadmin -m 0600 "$test_dir/id_ed25519.pub" /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
test_group=$(id -gn "$test_user")
install -d -o "$test_user" -g "$test_group" -m 0700 "/home/$test_user/.ssh"
install -o "$test_user" -g "$test_group" -m 0600 "$test_dir/id_ed25519.pub" "/home/$test_user/.ssh/authorized_keys"

id opsadmin
id "$test_user"
printf '%s\n' '--- group gate classification ---'
if id -nG opsadmin | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -Fx remote-access >/dev/null; then printf 'opsadmin_gate=member\n'; else exit 1; fi
